prospects.name: Saphir Capital Partners
prospects.brief_description: Saphir Capital Partners is a Luxembourg-domiciled private equity manager focused on value preservation and durability. It deploys capital across various control-oriented strategies including buyout, growth, restructuring, and turnaround, targeting mid-market companies in Europe.
